corrections.required_change: Every planner obligation must identify exact current file and symbol or operational boundary anchors, exact current or new test locations and observables, a concrete code or authority owner, finite required inputs with acquisition or decision contracts, a measurable closure condition, and supporting evidence IDs. Proposed component labels alone are not implementation anchors.

Add complete current-state matrices for all 25 registered sequences, every governed mechanical operation and raw or typed boundary, every intent-to-reuse lifecycle transition, every long-running controller and atomic-unit admission component, every durable transition/effect boundary including branch and multiple-run ownership, and every required metric producer, denominator, aggregation window, exclusion rule, and query status. Treat external automation internals as unproved and require black-box adapter acceptance rather than inventing facts.

Define the overhead acceptance contract explicitly: mechanical_seconds divided by governed_active_seconds must be at most 0.10 and should reach 0.05; report the observed value within the 5-to-10-percent band. Exclude user-approval wait, external service or rate-limit wait, and intentionally productive model or domain execution only when separately event-classified; never exclude local retries, command reconstruction, malformed-input recovery, guard or selector work, or correction overhead.

Replace generic host-adapter claims with a per-action enforcement matrix. For Bash, apply_patch, and MCP, ground PreToolUse denial or rewrite plus registry applicability selection. For unified shell, WebSearch or built-in browser paths, subagent launch, and any non-MCP remote workflow path not covered by PreToolUse, state that the current host cannot provide complete interception. A future governed runner may satisfy the requirement only by structurally withholding unsupported tools from the granted tool manifest or by a future host-owned pre-dispatch hook; if neither is available, the action class must fail visibly as unsupported and the package must carry that host capability as an explicit implementation dependency rather than claiming a present adapter.
